title: S&P Global Flash France PMI (Sep 2026) — 07:15 UTC / 03:15 ET, the first European print of the morning and the euro area's sub-50 member
source: EST: THREE primaries, all fetched direct 2026-09-09 by this event's own initial research. (1) S&P Global's forward PMI calendar, pmi.spglobal.com/Public/Release/ReleaseDates?language=en (HTTP 200, 23,858 bytes): 'September 23 ... 07:15 UTC S&P Global Flash France PMI', first in a European block the same page lists as 07:15 France, 07:30 Germany, 08:00 Eurozone, 08:30 UK, 13:45 US. (2) The publisher's own PAST-RELEASE archive, pmi.spglobal.com/Public/Release/PressReleases?language=en (HTTP 200, 92,883 bytes), records the slot actually DELIVERED one month earlier: 'August 21 2026 07:15 UTC | S&P Global Flash France PMI'. (3) NEW HERE, and stronger than either listing — the August Flash France release document itself, fetched as a PDF (HTTP 200, 121,095 bytes) and text-extracted in-session, states in its own embargo line: 'Embargoed until 0915 CEST (0715 UTC) 21 August 2026', with 'Data were collected 12-19 August 2026'. 07:15 UTC is 03:15 ET under EDT. Filed estimate on the standing schema gap market-events-data.ts carries — no confirmed-source prefix covers a private PMI compiler — not on date doubt; this lane's hard limits permit a flip only on IR:/BLS:/FED:. Honest asymmetry, inherited and re-checked: the calendar page publishes a release rule for the FINALS only ('Manufacturing PMI: first working day; Services PMI: third working day') and none for the flash, so the flash date rests on the listing and cannot be derived
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-09), reading the single prior proposal (...from-sp-global-flash-eurozone-pmi-2026-09-23.json) as input per EVENT-RESEARCH.md. TIER HELD AT low, on a measurement taken in the print's OWN hours on the tape that actually trades it — the construction the proposing ledger named as stronger and did not run ('a study on cash indices or on EURUSD would be the stronger construction and was NOT run'). Yahoo 5-minute bars on ^FCHI / ^GDAXI / ^STOXX50E, range=60d (delivered 2026-06-18..09-09, n=60 sessions), every headline claim computed as CAC minus DAX so the common European factor is removed. Paris and Xetra both open 07:00 UTC, so the 07:15 France print lands 15 minutes into the cash session and 15 minutes BEFORE Germany's — a window in which France has national data Germany does not. THE WINDOW IS QUIET. (a) CAC raw |move| 07:15-07:30 ranked p45 / p25 / p22 across the three flash days — 0 of 3 above its own median, 0 at p90. (b) CAC-DAX residual, same window: p52 / p47 / p63 — base rate. (c) The sharpest reading, and it points the other way from a footprint: over the whole flash morning 07:00-08:55 the CAC-DAX residual ranked p29 / p2 / p14, and over the full session 07:00-15:25 it ranked p7 / p0 / p33 — 3 of 3 below median in both, two in the bottom decile. On the mornings France gets its own national print ahead of Germany's, France-vs-Germany dispersion is at its NARROWEST, not its widest. INSTRUMENT POWER CHECKED, not assumed: on a 30-minute window the same construction fires on a genuine control — payrolls 2026-09-04, 12:30-12:55 UTC, CAC-DAX p90 — while the France flash window at that same width sits at p15 / p67 / p68. THE PROPOSING LEDGER'S NAMED GAP IS CLOSED WITH A NUMBER ('no primary weight figure for France and Germany inside the aggregate was collected'). Eurostat nama_10_a10, gross value added at current prices, 2025, fetched direct 2026-09-09: France is 13.4% of euro-area MANUFACTURING value added against Germany's 35.7%, but 19.7% of private-services value added against Germany's 26.4% (robust to excluding real estate: 18.6% vs 26.0%). So the 07:15 France print pre-announces the 08:00 aggregate mainly through its SERVICES leg, where it carries three-quarters of Germany's weight, and barely at all through manufacturing, where it carries one third. France and Germany together are 49.1% of manufacturing and 46.0% of private-services value added — the pre-announcement mechanic the sibling could only state structurally is about HALF the aggregate by weight. FRANCE IS THE AGGREGATE'S DRAG, AND THIS IS THE FRANCE-SPECIFIC FACT NO EUROZONE-LEVEL LEDGER CARRIES: in August the Eurozone composite printed 52.1, a 9-month high, while France's flash composite printed 48.8 — CONTRACTING, a 2-month low (services 48.4, manufacturing PMI 51.5), per the release PDF itself. Flash-to-final revision computed first-hand from three primaries and it runs uniformly DOWN: composite 48.8 flash -> 48.5 final (-0.3), services 48.4 -> 48.0 (-0.4), manufacturing PMI 51.5 -> 51.1 (-0.4), against the publisher's own Eurozone-level absolute averages of 0.3/0.3/0.2 — n=1 month, recorded not sized. The mechanism is in the primaries: the flash collected 12-19 Aug, the manufacturing final 12-21 Aug, the services final 12-25 Aug. TWO DATED CONTEXT ITEMS the publisher's own economist states and this calendar cannot get from an aggregate release: extreme August heat is named in-document as a drag firms cited ('we should perhaps discount the August numbers somewhat'), which gives September a mechanical bounce-back candidate on the services side; and 'with the 2027 election period looming, companies remain cautious towards the year ahead, with confidence well below its long-term average', with 'political uncertainty' named among the factors dampening confidence. Nothing proposed to the calendar by this research, deliberately and on the sibling's stated precedent: France's own finals (2026-10-01 and 2026-10-05, both 07:50 UTC, derived from the publisher's stated first-/third-working-day rule and the observed 2026-09-01 / 2026-09-03 slots) fall on dates this calendar ALREADY tracks at the aggregate level, and filing every European print after measuring a below-base-rate residual would add noise on the strength of a null. FALSIFIER ON THE TIER ITSELF: if on 2026-09-23 the CAC-DAX residual over 07:00-08:55 UTC ranks ABOVE its own trailing median, or the CAC's raw 07:15-07:30 move reaches p90, the quiet-morning null takes its first contradiction and the tier is re-argued rather than patched.
